meta.name: deploy-to-vercel
meta.description: Deploy applications and websites to Vercel. Use when the user requests deployment actions like "deploy my app", "deploy and give me the link", "push this live", or "create a preview deployment".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 一键将应用部署到 Vercel 并获取链接
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要将应用快速部署到 Vercel 并获取预览链接
copy.tagline_en: Deploy your app to Vercel and get a live link with one command
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently deploy apps to Vercel and need instant preview URLs

howto.what: 当你说要部署应用时，Claude会检查项目是否已关联Vercel、是否有git仓库、是否安装并登录了Vercel CLI，然后自动选择最优方式部署到Vercel，最后返回预览链接。
howto.when: 当你说出“deploy my app”、“deploy and give me the link”等关键词，或要求创建预览部署、推送上线时触发。

say.note: Claude会尝试先关联项目再部署

say.text: 把当前项目推送到Vercel预览
say.note: 会自动选择git推送或CLI部署

howto.what_en: When you ask to deploy an app, Claude checks if the project is linked to Vercel, has a git remote, and if the Vercel CLI is installed/authenticated. It then auto-selects the best method to deploy to Vercel and returns a preview URL.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "deploy my app", "deploy and give me the link", or ask to create a preview deployment or push live.

say_en.note: Claude will try to link the project first

say_en.text: Push this project to Vercel preview
say_en.note: Auto-selects git push or CLI deploy
Returns preview URL and claim link
